t: Introduction and overview — Queen Elizabeth-class Aircraft Carrier
name: Introduction and overview — Queen Elizabeth-class Aircraft Carrier — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Queen Elizabeth-class Aircraft Carrier
description: Introduction and overview of the Queen Elizabeth-class Aircraft Carrier: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Royal Navy's Queen Elizabeth class — two ships, 65,000 tons — are the largest warships ever built for Britain, operating F-35B Lightning stealth fighters from ski-jump decks. Their twin-island design separates ship and air operations. HMS Queen Elizabeth led a 2021 global deployment to the Pacific. Baseline facts: Royal Navy carrier; 2 built; 65,000 tons; F-35B STOVL; twin-island design..
how_it_works: Buoyancy supports the hull; propellers driven by diesel, turbine, or nuclear plant provide thrust; rudders and thrusters steer; stability comes from hull form and ballast.
